evidence: Implements an in-tree test runner and expression-decomposing assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} to replace Boost.Test.
rationale: Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree framework, resolving long-standing maintainability goals discussed in RFC #34666 and issue #8670. The new framework improves failure diagnostics via expression decomposition and eliminates platform-specific runtime issues like undersized signal stacks (#36045).
